metadata.description:
Cyberweek t-shirts, challenge coins, and POAPs are a continuing tradition for TeamSPS. The design for these memorabilia is always done after Cyberweek so that we can pull in "the story" of each year. 2025 was the year of matching focus and intensity to the needs of our customers.
	
This year's incredible execution during Cyberweek resulted in a record-breaking Cyber Monday, record-breaking hourly peak for documents, and flawless 100% uptime. The design highlights the main character of this year's story. Our teams were easily able to identify the unusual activity of over 130,000 documents related to chickens suddenly pecking their way into to our network and we didn't waste time clucking around to investigate. No feathers were ruffled as we proactively connected with our customer and confirmed the orders were real - all without any disruption to our system or customers.

Designs by the incredible Meghan McDermott.
metadata.name: TeamSPS Cyberweek 2025
